claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Digoxigenin is a cardenolide aglycone that at 2.5 uM is expected to act primarily as a Na+/K+-ATPase (ATPase) inhibitor, but its weak potency and poor membrane permeability relative to cardiac glycosides make broad, potent cytotoxicity unlikely.
